What is the exact value of $\tan\left(\frac{13\pi}{12}\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $\frac{13\pi}{12} = \frac{11\pi}{6} - \frac{3\pi}{4}$.

*Hint:* Use the fact that $75^\circ = 300^\circ - 225^\circ$.
